race.name: Texwech Tayeawlh
race.host: Bellingham Bay Outrigger Paddlers and Autumn Rose
race.summary: “The Canoe Race to Eliza Island,” co-hosted by Bellingham Bay Outrigger Paddlers and Autumn Rose Canoe Club from the Lummi Nation Stommish Grounds. The 14-mile iron course runs south between Lummi and Portage islands, rounds Eliza Island and returns; the 5-mile short course is for novice and youth crews. OC6 only, unlimited or spec. Camping at the Stommish Grounds included with entry.

courses.label: Iron course
courses.note: South between Lummi and Portage islands, around Eliza Island and back.
